gbm_population_evidence.quote: Brain Cancer; Glioblastoma; Metastatic Cancer; Leptomeningeal Metastasis; Recurrent Glioblastoma
Cohort C: Participants with recurrent glioblastoma requiring neurosurgical resection/biopsy

candidate_evidence.quote: All participants will receive T-DXd prior to indicated brain tumor resection/biopsy

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Concentrations will be presented as brain tumor:plasma ratios across brain lesions

role_evidence.quote: All participants will receive T-DXd prior to indicated brain tumor resection/biopsy

agents.drug_class_hint: HER2-directed antibody-drug conjugate (topoisomerase I inhibitor payload)

source_quote.quote: Has a history of Her2 expression or activating Her2-mutation

flag.reason: HER2 is required for the metastatic cohorts A and B; the recurrent glioblastoma cohort C has no stated HER2 requirement in eligibility, although outcomes mention Her2-expressing glioblastoma.

coder_notes: Basket-type design: HER2-expressing/ERBB2-mutant metastatic cancer with CNS metastases (cohorts A, B) plus recurrent glioblastoma (cohort C). Window-of-opportunity design with tumour penetration as primary outcome. Cohort C eligibility is simply recurrent glioblastoma.
